review_method: Traced each service NPC or shared service function through its full script body against the currently loaded Hercules source, checking gating conditions, costs, and outcomes.

entries.title: Unidentified Machine / Expert Repairman (Einbroch, airship quest): free repair with an off-by-one bug
conditions: Hidden NPC at ein_in01, gated to only offer this branch once the airship-quest progression variable kain_ticket exceeds 12; otherwise it presents unrelated flavor dialogue.
Unlike every other reviewed repair service, this one is free: it reports the broken-item count via getbrokencount() and, on confirmation, repairs items with no Zeny charge at all.

Notable bug: the repair loop is `for (.@i = 1; .@i < .@mugi; ++.@i) repair(.@i);` where .@mugi is the broken-item count from getbrokencount(). This iterates .@i from 1 up to (but not including) .@mugi, so it calls repair() on only .@mugi - 1 of the .@mugi broken items -- the last broken slot is never repaired in this branch, unlike the repairmain shared function and Repair Man (Izlude), both of which use inclusive getbrokenid()-based loops that cover every broken slot.

required_source_literals: ein_in01,117,80,3	script	Unidentified Machine#as	HIDDEN_NPC,{//Official hidden name "#ein"

entries.title: Cash Shop item scripts: storage and skill/status reset triggered by consuming an item, not by an NPC
conditions: F_CashStore (used by the Kafra Card item) simply calls openstorage with no cost, gate, or NPC context beyond the item's own use-restrictions defined in item_db.conf; it is not an NPC service and has no map/cell location.

F_CashReset (used by the Neuralizer item) requires Class != Job_Novice, Weight == 0, and no mount/falcon/cart/cash-mount equipped; on success it calls resetskill and sc_end SC_ALL (clearing all active status changes), then consumes one Neuralizer if the player still holds it.

Both are triggered by using a consumable item from the player's inventory, not by talking to an NPC; recorded here for completeness since they matched the literal storage/skill_reset scan, but they belong to the item-effect system rather than the NPC-service system the rest of this file covers.

entries.title: Cool Event Corp. Staff (Hugel/Rachel/Veins): reserve-points-exempt Kafra variant
conditions: Three real NPCs (Hugel, Rachel, Veins) each call F_KafSet to populate the route table for their own map, then F_ZondaStaff with a menu-variant argument (0 at Hugel: no Teleport Service offered; 1 at Rachel/Veins: full menu including Teleport Service), then set a fixed savepoint on close.

This is the 'Zonda/Cool Event Corp.' variant already referenced in kafra_employee_core_services' fee-exemption notes: its Use Storage call passes exempt-code 6 with a flat 40 Zeny fee, its Rent a Pushcart call passes exempt-code 6 with a flat 800 Zeny fee, and its Teleport Service call passes exempt-code 6 -- in all three, code 6 means no Special Reserve Points are granted for the payment (F_KafStor/F_KafCart/F_KafTele's shared logic skips the RESRVPTS award only when their exempt-code argument equals 6).

Save, Storage, Pushcart, and Storage Password Service share the same gating/cost rules as the main F_KafStor/F_KafCart/F_SetKafCode helpers reviewed in kafra_employee_core_services; only the fee amounts and reserve-point exemption differ here.

entries.title: Deviruchi (Niflheim): paid divorce for married characters
conditions: Requires the player to currently have a partner (getpartnerid() must be nonzero); unmarried characters only receive mocking dialogue and no service branch.
Costs a flat 2,500,000 Zeny, refused if the player's Zeny is 2,499,999 or lower.
On success the script clears wedding_sign, sets SP to 0 and HP to 1 (a scripted side-effect cost, not a Zeny fee), then calls divorce to end the marriage.
The player must actively opt in twice (an initial 'yes, divorce me' choice and a second 'give me a divorce right now' confirmation); declining either ends the dialogue without cost.

entries.title: Hypnotist (Izlude): free stat/skill reset for eligible low-level first classes
conditions: Eligibility is restricted to Swordman/Acolyte/Mage/Thief/Archer/Merchant through the base-class range check, plus Taekwon, Gunslinger, and Ninja classes explicitly, and requires Base Level under 50.
Before either reset, the player must have 0 carried inventory weight and no pushcart equipped (checkcart() must be false); the NPC explains both requirements and refuses to proceed otherwise.

The service is free (no Zeny or item cost) and offers unlimited resets as scripted (no cooldown or per-account counter observed in this branch); choosing 'Reset stats' calls resetstatus, choosing 'Reset skills' calls resetskill.

entries.title: startpoint (Izlude training rooms): automatic first-touch navigation prompt, not a player-requested service
conditions: This is a HIDDEN_WARP_NPC OnTouch trigger covering the tile at (18,26)/(18,27) in the Izlude training rooms (iz_int and its 4 instanced duplicates iz_int01-04), not a menu-driven NPC a player interacts with.

On first touch per character (gated by the character variable izintspawn, set to 1 immediately so it fires only once), it calls navigateto("int_land", NAV_NONE, 1) to open the client's navigation overlay pointing toward the training-room exit; it grants no item, currency, or persistent state beyond the one-time flag.

Recorded here for completeness since it matched the literal navigateto() scan, but it is explicitly not an NPC-provided service in the sense the rest of this file covers -- there is no cost, menu, or repeatable player request.

entries.title: Kafra Employee: storage, guild storage, pushcart rental, teleport, and reserve points
conditions: The shared F_Kafra menu function offers a subset of Save / Use Storage / Use Guild Storage / Rent a Pushcart / Use Teleport Service / Check Other Information, chosen per call site by a numbered menu-variant argument (case 1-10 in the source switch); most Kafra NPCs use variant 0 (the full default menu) or 5 (NPC supplies its own welcome text).

Use Storage requires Basic Skill level 6 or higher (waived for classes with SU_BASIC_SKILL) and either a Free Ticket for Kafra Storage (consumed if held) or the per-NPC storage fee in Zeny; each 5 Zeny of fee paid (except the Zonda/Cool Event Corp. variant) grants 1 Special Reserve Point.
Use Guild Storage is free but fails with a busy message if another guild member is already inside the guild storage; it is not gated by the Basic Skill check that regular storage uses.

Rent a Pushcart requires a Merchant-class base class and at least skill level 1 in Pushcart (MC_PUSHCART), refuses if a cart is already equipped, and otherwise consumes a Free Ticket for the Cart Service or charges the per-NPC cart fee in Zeny (48 Special Reserve Points on payment, except the Zonda/Cool Event Corp. variant).

Use Teleport Service lists destinations and per-destination Zeny prices fixed by the Kafra NPC's own map (see route_table); it is unavailable at the Einbroch-area menu variant (menu-variant 4), consumes a Free Ticket for Kafra Transportation if held, otherwise charges the listed fare and grants 1 Special Reserve Point per 16 Zeny paid (except the Zonda/Cool Event Corp. variant).

Check Other Information exposes the player's accumulated Special Reserve Points total, a storage password sub-service, and (outside Port Malaya/Rune Knight menu contexts) a minimap ping of nearby Kafra-related points of interest; it does not grant or consume anything by itself.

Guild Castle Kafra NPCs (menu-variant argument 0 combined with a separate 'called from guild castle' flag) override the menu to a free Storage/Guild Storage/Pushcart/Teleport set with no Zeny or ticket cost, per the getarg(0)==2 branch.

Each of the 49 indexed call sites in docs/npc-service-clues.v1.json under service_kind 'kafra_menu' instantiates this shared contract with its own menu-variant, storage fee, and cart fee taken directly from its callfunc argument list; this review does not re-verify each individual NPC's dialogue flavor text, only the shared mechanics.
entries.route_table_note: Any Kafra NPC on a map not listed here (or whose menu variant excludes teleport) offers no teleport destinations; the table is populated per-map by F_KafSet and is exhaustive for the maps it lists as of this review.

entries.title: Kafra Leilah (Al De Baran HQ): standalone save/storage/cart menu
conditions: This NPC does not call the shared F_Kafra function; it is a standalone hand-written variant offering Save (fixed savepoint at aldeba_in 96,179), Use Storage, and Rent a Pushcart.

Use Storage costs a fixed 20 Zeny (1 Special Reserve Point per 5 Zeny, same rate as the shared helper) and checks the storage password via F_CheckKafCode, but does not apply the Basic Skill level 6 gate that the shared F_KafStor helper enforces elsewhere.
Rent a Pushcart at this NPC delegates to the shared F_KafCart helper, so its cost and class/skill gating match the reviewed kafra_employee_core_services conditions for that action.

entries.title: Weapon/armor refiners: classic dialogue-menu refining (refine UI disabled on this server)
conditions: All five refiner NPCs indexed by the 'refine_ui_access' clue kind (Suhnbi#cash at payon, Fulerr at lhz_in02, MightyHammer#re, Vestri#pay at payon_in01, and Shadow Blacksmith#nomal at itemmall) gate the interactive openrefineryui() client dialog behind the server config flag conf/map/battle/feature.conf 'features/replace_refine_npcs', read via getbattleflag("features/replace_refine_npcs").

That flag is 'false' in feature.conf and is not overridden anywhere under Hercules/conf/import on this server, so openrefineryui() is never reached; every refiner NPC falls through to its classic select()-menu refine flow instead. This is a configuration fact checked directly against the active conf tree, not an inference from the script alone.

The worked example, Suhnbi#cash, lists only the player's currently equipped gear, refuses items with getequipisenableref() false or already at +10, and branches its required material/cost by weapon level (level 1-4 weapons use different callsub S_RefineValidate cost tiers; non-weapon/level-0 gear uses a separate tier) using the same Enriched Oridecon/Elunium materials as the normal weapon-refine tables already exported in docs/refine.v1.json. This review does not re-derive those odds; it establishes that these NPCs are access points to that already-reviewed mechanic, not a separate one.

Fulerr, MightyHammer#re, and Vestri#pay route through shared refinemain/refinenew helper functions carrying the same getbattleflag gate and an equivalent equipped-item menu; Shadow Blacksmith#nomal is a distinct implementation with its own fixed 20,000 Zeny refining fee for Shadow equipment, separate from the normal refine material/cost tables.

entries.title: Repair Man (Izlude): broken-equipment repair for 5000 Zeny per item
conditions: Requires at least one broken equipment slot (getbrokencount() > 0); otherwise the NPC only says there is nothing to repair.
Cost is a flat 5000 Zeny per broken item, computed as 5000 * getbrokencount() and shown to the player before confirmation; the NPC refuses if Zeny is insufficient.
On success it calls repairall (not per-item repair), fixing every broken equipped item at once for the quoted total.

entries.title: Repairman (shared function): flat-rate repair-all for broken equipped gear
conditions: The shared `repairmain` function (npc/merchants/refine.txt) is called by 15 static NPCs across 2 loaded script files, all named 'Repairman' in dialogue except the Prontera-inn variant, which speaks as 'Grendal'; each of the 15 indexed call sites under service_kind 'repair_shared_function' in docs/npc-service-clues.v1.json instantiates this same contract.
Cost is a flat 5000 Zeny per broken equipped item, computed as getbrokenid()-loop count times 5000 and quoted to the player before confirmation.

If the broken-item count has changed between the quote and the player confirming (re-counted via a second getbrokenid loop), the NPC refuses with a 'wait... equip the items you need to repair' message instead of repairing a stale count.

On success it repairs each broken item individually via repeated repair(<slot>) calls (not a single repairall() call, unlike the separately reviewed Repair Man in Izlude academy, which does use repairall).
If the player has no broken items, the NPC says so and ends without charging anything.

required_source_literals: switch(select("Actually, I do have some items...", "None at the moment.")) {

entries.title: Standalone paid/gated storage NPCs outside the Kafra network
conditions: Logistics Manager (dali,112,95,4): requires Basic Skill level 6 or higher and 200 Zeny, deducted before calling openstorage(); an insufficient-Zeny or insufficient-skill message is shown instead of the charge.
Item Storage#01 (dic_in01,254,119,0), a locked safe: costs a flat 500 Zeny with no skill-level check, deducted before calling openstorage.

Storekeeper#mal (malangdo,184,139,4): requires Basic Skill level 6 or higher; price and currency depend on the character variable ep13_yong1 — 1 Malang Special Can or 1,500 Zeny once ep13_yong1 exceeds 999, otherwise 2 cans or 3,000 Zeny — payable in either Malang Special Cans or Zeny at the player's choice, deducted/consumed before calling openstorage.
Drawer#mora_warehouse (mora,48,128,0), a hidden NPC: requires Basic Skill level 6 or higher (via basicskillcheck()) and a flat 100 Zeny, deducted before calling openstorage.

Butler Karlex (job_gun,216,138,4): a free temporary storage offered only during the Rebellion class Advancement Test sequence, with no Zeny or skill-level check observed in this branch; scope limited to that test context.

None of these five NPCs route through the shared F_Kafra/F_KafStor helper reviewed in kafra_employee_core_services; each implements its own fee and gating logic independently, so a change to the shared Kafra storage fee/skill rule does not affect these.

Cat Hand Agent (mid_camp,62,125,4): requires Basic Skill level 6 or higher and a flat 60 Zeny, deducted before calling openstorage; the same offer recurs identically across three separate quest-stage dialogue branches in the same NPC script.

Cat Hand Agent#spl (spl_fild02,25,211,4): the same 60 Zeny / Basic Skill level 6 storage offer as the Cat Hand Agent above, independently implemented in a separate quest script and recurring across three quest-stage branches there too.

Kafra Guide Trainer#ac (iz_ac01,95,46,5), an Izlude Academy tutorial NPC: requires Basic Skill level 6 or higher, then either consumes a Cargo Free Ticket or charges 500 Zeny (granting 5 Special Reserve Points on the Zeny path) before calling openstorage; implemented independently of the shared F_KafStor helper despite matching its fee/reserve-point shape.

Goods Cabinet (moc_para01,173,120,0 and moc_para01,170,120,0, two hidden duplicate NPCs sharing one function): requires the player to hold a Para Team Mark (or its bound variant), Basic Skill level 6 or higher, and a flat 500 Zeny, deducted before calling openstorage; the skill-level check runs before the Zeny deduction, so a failed check does not charge the fee.

entries.title: Kafra Employee#sn (Aldebaran): unofficial cart rental for Super Novices
conditions: Gated to BaseJob == Job_SuperNovice; this is a dedicated Kafra Employee variant outside the shared F_KafCart helper, offered because ordinary Kafra Employees refuse to rent Super Novices a cart.
Requires no cart already equipped (checkcart()) and at least 1900 Zeny; charges a flat 1900 Zeny service fee and grants 190 Special Reserve Points.

Notable mismatch: the 1900 Zeny fee is charged and Reserve Points granted unconditionally once the Zeny check passes, but the actual `setcart` grant is separately gated behind `getskilllv("MC_PUSHCART") > 0`. A Super Novice who has not learned Push Cart pays the full fee and receives no cart, with no refund path in this branch.
